title: D2NET-Settings.json
description: Settings file written at <repo-root>/.D2NET/D2NET-Settings.json by D2NET.Init. Mirrors a subset of the workspace database `setting` table plus structured connection details and the approved exclusion list. Updated for the SQLite pivot (clarification Q6).

schema_version.description: Format version. Always 1 in this MVP.

source_dir.description: Source directory name relative to the repository root. No path separators; no '..'.

target_extension.description: Target directory suffix (e.g. '_net'). May be empty.

target_dir.description: Target directory name relative to the repository root.

excluded_directories.description: Sorted-ascending list of forward-slash relative paths under source_dir that were approved for exclusion.

db_file.description: Absolute path to the workspace SQLite database file.

connection_string.description: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite connection string of the form 'Data Source=<db_file>'.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the fresh init that produced this file.
